{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Thermal base layer, fitted crew-neck, hip length, warm grey #8A8D91, merino wool blend
Refined knit sweater, slim fit with a fine ribbed crew neck, hip length, deep burgundy #6D2433, fine merino wool
Wool trousers, straight leg with a high waist, full length to the ankle bone, charcoal #3A3D42, textured wool flannel
Lined overcoat for deep frost, knee-length with a stand collar and a hidden zip-and-button closure, graphite #2E3136, water-repellent wool-blend outer with a warm insulated lining
Ankle boots, rounded toe with a low block heel and grippy rubber sole, black #1A1A1A, waterproof treated leather that wipes clean of road salt
Wool socks, mid-calf, heather grey #6F7378, merino wool
Knit beanie, close fit with a folded cuff, charcoal #3A3D42, wool and cashmere blend
Scarf, wide and long, wrapped twice, camel #B58B5A, soft brushed wool
Gloves, full-finger, black #1A1A1A, lined leather
Tote bag, structured with a top zip and a shoulder strap, black #1A1A1A, water-resistant coated leather

Why this outfit works: The refined knit with straight wool trousers keeps the look neat and office-appropriate, and the burgundy adds a polished touch against the charcoal. The thermal base layer and lined overcoat give real warmth for a 20-minute walk in deep frost. Waterproof leather ankle boots with a grippy sole handle snow and road salt, and they stay smart enough to wear at your desk. The camel scarf, beanie and gloves protect against the cold and tie the palette together."}
